tested_on: XCP-ng 8.3 (single host, two VMs without an operating system) nested in QEMU/KVM, through Xen Orchestra 6 (REST API 0.41, also with a user that only has the built-in Read only role) and straight from the pool master (XAPI JSON-RPC): hosts, VMs, MAC addresses, storage repositories, hard reboot / start / shutdown, wrong password, certificate fingerprint (right and wrong), the diagnostic
reviews.notes: Written and lab-tested on 2026-10-28 with the assistant Claude on a throwaway XCP-ng and Xen Orchestra. Reviewed, not verified: the lab had no guest tools (the IP addresses of VMs follow the Xen documentation and a simulated test), one host only, no XenServer, no shared or XOSTOR storage, no Active Directory logins. Plain http is refused unless switched on.
